state_shootings.summary: Guinéenews reports security warning shots and an attributed protester account of a friend hit in the hand. AfricaGuinee attributes live fire to security agents. Firearm occurrence is explicit; injury identity and claims remain attributed.

notes: Actual blockade January 8 evening resumed January 9 morning. Protest targets an extortionate state checkpoint. Guinéenews reports stones thrown at a soldier's vehicle. Verite224 instead attributes same-location January 8–9 unrest to electricity outages; unresolved episode/demand conflict retained rather than creating a duplicate.
